items.headline: Delta flights in and out of Atlanta delayed due to system outage
items.summary: All Delta flights in and out of Atlanta are facing significant delays on Sunday due to a problem with the system that calculates a plane's weight and balance. Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is Delta's largest hub and one of the busiest airports in the world. While only Delta is impacted at the moment, disruptions at […]
lines: Reported by The Verge: All Delta flights in and out of Atlanta are facing significant delays on Sunday due to a problem with the system that calculates a plane's weight and balance.
Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is Delta's largest hub and one of the busiest airports in the world, and only Delta is affected at the moment.
For IT teams, the outage shows how a single system failure can delay operations at a major hub.

items.headline: Hackers exploit GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers, KVM devices
items.summary: GL.iNet has confirmed that hackers exploited a vulnerability in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices, with some affected users reporting backdoors and reverse shells giving remote access to infected devices. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: GL.iNet has confirmed that hackers exploited a vulnerability in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices.
Some affected users reported backdoors and reverse shells that gave remote access to infected devices.
IT teams that manage GL.iNet routers or KVM devices may want to review how those devices are reached through cloud remote management.

items.headline: The Technology Behind More Precise Finding With Galaxy SmartTag3 and SmartThings
items.summary: Samsung Electronics launched Galaxy SmartTag3, a compact tracker that helps locate personal belongings or pets. Weighing just 9.15 g — approximately 33% lighter and 35% smaller by volume than its predecessor — Galaxy SmartTag3 offers improved portability and battery life of up to 550 days under standard usage or 790 days in Power Saving Mode. […]
lines: Samsung Electronics launched Galaxy SmartTag3, a compact tracker that helps locate personal belongings or pets.
The tracker weighs 9.15 g, about 33% lighter and 35% smaller by volume than its predecessor, with battery life of up to 550 days under standard usage or 790 days in Power Saving Mode.
The smaller size and longer battery life offer improved portability and ownership convenience for users who rely on the device to find belongings or pets.

items.headline: RBI releases 2026 list of Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs)
items.summary: State Bank of India, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank continue to be identified as Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs) under the same bucketing structure as in the 2025 list of D-SIBs . The additional Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) requirement for these D-SIBs will be in addition to the capital conservation buffer. lines: The Reserve Bank of India released its 2026 list of Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs). State Bank of India, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank remain on the list under the same bucketing structure as the 2025 list.

Additional Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) requirements, as a percentage of Risk Weighted Assets, are 0.80% for State Bank of India, 0.40% for HDFC Bank and 0.20% for ICICI Bank, in addition to the capital conservation buffer.
Banking, compliance and finance teams tracking capital requirements should note the updated D-SIB list and its additional CET1 requirements.

source.name: Reserve Bank of India press releases

items.headline: CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
items.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers are now exploiting a recently patched critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability in the wild. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers are exploiting a recently patched critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability in the wild.
The flaw is described as a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Cisco Expressway.
IT teams running Cisco Expressway should confirm that the patch is applied, since attacks on this flaw are already occurring.

items.headline: Hackers Exploit Critical ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated RCE
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have urged users to discontinue using a legacy ASP.NET anti-CSRF library named Idunno.AntiCsrf ("Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll") following the discovery of a critical vulnerability that has been exploited in the wild. lines: Reported by The Hacker News: Researchers urged users to stop using the legacy ASP.NET anti-CSRF library Idunno.AntiCsrf after a critical vulnerability was found being exploited in the wild.
The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-131914, has a CVSS score of 9.3 out of 10.0 and affects versions 0.9.1.0 and 0.9.1 Beta. The headline describes it as allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.
Developers and IT teams using this legacy library should identify affected versions and plan to move off it, as the source advises.

The activity revolves around CVE-2026-84869 (CVSS score: 9.9), a critical ScreenConnect client flaw that allows a guest to transfer and execute a malicious payload on a connecting technician's host. "On November 12, 2026, we observed one managed service
lines: Reported by The Hacker News: Threat actors are exploiting a now-patched ConnectWise ScreenConnect flaw to target managed service provider (MSP) servers.
The flaw, CVE-2026-84869 (CVSS score 9.9), is a critical ScreenConnect client flaw that allows a guest to transfer and execute a malicious payload on a connecting technician's host.
The flaw matters to MSPs and technicians who use ScreenConnect for remote connections, because a guest session can reach a technician's host.

items.headline: N-able Discloses Critical Mail Assure Vulnerability Found During Breach Investigation
items.summary: N-able yesterday disclosed a critical flaw it found while investigating the breach of its Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud, an email filtering service it runs for managed service providers. lines: Reported by The Hacker News: N-able disclosed a critical flaw it found while investigating a breach of its Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud email filtering service.
The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-134624, is a server-side request forgery (SSRF) bug that allowed a user with high-level API access to open connections to internal systems of the user's choosing.
The disclosure matters to MSPs that rely on N-able's email filtering service for their customers.

items.headline: Apple will focus on affordable models in early 2027 - iPhone 18e, new iPad, new MacBook Neo
items.summary: When he took over the CEO position, John Ternus said that he wants Apple to move away from the traditional big September announcement and to launch new products more often. We’re already seeing that – the September iPhone event only brought the two iPhone 18 Pro models and Apple’s first foldable. The remaining iPhone models will come next year. It will start with the iPhone 18e in the February-March time frame, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. This is when Apple is expected to release iOS 27.4. The “.4” releases tend to be a major milestone in the iOS release cycle – any features that...
lines: Reported by GSMArena news: Apple plans to focus on more affordable models in early 2027, including the iPhone 18e, a new iPad and a new MacBook Neo.
According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the iPhone 18e is expected in the February-March time frame, around when Apple is expected to release iOS 27.4.
Apple CEO John Ternus said he wants the company to move away from a traditional big September announcement and launch new products more often.

items.headline: The End of CRM Busywork: How Agentforce Coworker Helps Run Your Small Business
items.summary: Agentforce Coworker is now available for small businesses at Salesforce, and the future looks bright.
lines: Salesforce has made Agentforce Coworker available for small businesses.
The Salesforce Blog describes the product as a tool for handling CRM work and helping run a small business.
Small business owners and their IT staff may find this a new Salesforce option for daily CRM tasks.

items.headline: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director
items.summary: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board.
lines: NVIDIA announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President, Chief Executive Officer and Board member, effective immediately.
The NVIDIA Board made the reinstatement, according to the NVIDIA Newsroom.
Business users and IT teams that track NVIDIA leadership and board changes can note this update.

lines: Reported by The Hacker News: A critical security flaw has been disclosed in the binary-parser library that could let an attacker who controls parser definitions execute arbitrary code.
The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-134814, is a code injection issue in binary-parser versions prior to 2.3.1 and is listed with CVSS scores of 9.2 / 8.1.
